headline: First Human Trial of Epigenetic Reprogramming for Anti-Aging Receives FDA Clearance
reason: Life Biosciences received Investigational New Drug (IND) clearance from the FDA in 2026 to initiate the first human trial of ER-100, an epigenetic reprogramming therapy, targeting optic neuropathies. This represents a significant milestone in human-centric longevity research, marking the inaugural human trial of a cellular reprogramming technology designed to reverse cellular aging.

headline: Global Fossil Fuel Emissions Show Slight Drop in 2026, Though Linked to Iran Conflict
reason: A new study released on November 10, 2026, by the Global Carbon Project, indicates a 0.4% decrease in global heat-trapping carbon dioxide emissions from fossil fuels in 2026 compared to the previous year.
